This section explains how the automated tests work. For practical steps and input choices, start with Your first check. Unfamiliar terms are explained in the glossary.

tests/data/static-preview-translations/qga-static-preview-texts.data.ts

Bundled source snapshot. Credential-like literals are omitted. Line numbers correspond to the audited repository file; this page is for reading and is not executable test code.

17  */

84 /** Visible text → expected occurrence count inside the phone-mockup preview. */
85 export type QgaPreviewTextCounts = Readonly<Record<string, number>>
86 
87 export interface QgaStaticPreviewTextEntry {
88     /** Hardcoded demo strings identical in every locale */
89     readonly shared: QgaPreviewTextCounts
90     /** Resolved translation values per locale (exact-match friendly) */
91     readonly locales: Readonly<Record<QgaLocale, QgaPreviewTextCounts>>
92     /**
93      * Strings that appear inside a longer text node (e.g. "Open hours - Open now").
94      * Assert with toContainText / substring count — not exact getByText.
95      */
96     readonly contains: Readonly<Record<QgaLocale, QgaPreviewTextCounts>>
97     /**
98      * Pairs of mutually exclusive strings (e.g. Open now / Closed).
99      * After WeekHours hydration, exactly one string from each pair is visible.
100      */
101     readonly exactlyOneOf: Readonly<
102         Record<QgaLocale, readonly (readonly [string, string])[]>
103     >
104 }
105
